description: The Secretary is the recordkeeping and governance backbone of the GNGRLL board. This role records meeting minutes and the elections/positions roster, publishes the agenda and notes to the board after each meeting, and maintains the league's governing documents — chiefly the annual review, update, and upload of the Constitution & By-laws to Little League International. The Secretary (a role that has historically combined with the League Info Officer) also handles recurring bulk communications such as Opening Day snack shack volunteer recruitment.

calendar.title: Constitution & By-laws review and upload to LLI (fall cycle)
calendar.description: Review and update the league Constitution & By-laws and upload the current version to Little League International. Treated as a recurring governance obligation each cycle.

calendar.title: Record annual officer slate / elections roster
calendar.description: Capture the elected officer slate and positions roster (voting officers with owning role and term year, plus non-voting staff and open seats) in the minutes when the board holds elections. GNGRLL has run elections in Oct, Nov, and March cycles.

calendar.title: Constitution & By-laws review and upload to LLI
calendar.description: Recurring review/update of the Constitution & By-laws with upload to Little League International, including any newly adopted policies (e.g., Social Media Policy, advertising/sponsorship policy under review).

calendar.title: Publish meeting agenda and minutes to the board
calendar.description: After each board meeting, distribute the agenda and approved minutes via document link so members can review and flag omissions. Standing recordkeeping duty tied to the monthly/bi-weekly meeting cadence.

calendar.title: Opening Day Snack Shack volunteer recruitment blast
calendar.description: Send the bulk Snack Shack volunteer recruitment email to a division's families ahead of Opening Day, using the Sign Up Genius link to fill concession slots (children/players not permitted in the snack shack for the event).

calendar.title: Constitution & By-laws review and upload to LLI (spring cycle)
calendar.description: Recurring in-season review/upload of the governing documents to LLI, ensuring the charter-year version on file reflects any mid-year policy adoptions.

calendar.title: Constitution & By-laws review and upload to LLI (year-end)
calendar.description: End-of-fiscal-year review and update of the Constitution & By-laws with upload to Little League International, closing out the governance cycle before Oct 1 reset.

tasks.title: Record meeting minutes and elections/positions roster
tasks.description: Serve as recorder at board meetings (president typically facilitates): capture attendees/quorum, the positions and elections roster with owning role and term year, motions/votes (mover, seconder, amount/cap, outcome), and action items. Note any new positions created by motion.

tasks.title: Distribute agenda and approved minutes to the board
tasks.description: Compile and share the meeting agenda and notes via a document link after each meeting; solicit corrections and log omissions so the running minutes stay accurate.

tasks.title: Review, update, and upload Constitution & By-laws to LLI
tasks.description: Complete the recurring governance obligation: review the Constitution & By-laws, incorporate adopted policy changes, and upload the updated document to Little League International.

tasks.title: Re-upload Constitution & By-laws after mid-season policy changes
tasks.description: Refresh the governing documents on file with LLI following any adopted amendments (e.g., division rules, social media / advertising-sponsorship policy, new board roles) during the pre-season and in-season cycle.

tasks.title: Year-end Constitution & By-laws review and upload
tasks.description: Perform the closing-cycle review/update of the Constitution & By-laws and upload to LLI ahead of the Oct 1 fiscal-year reset.

tasks.title: Send Opening Day Snack Shack volunteer recruitment email
tasks.description: Bulk-email a division's families to fill Snack Shack volunteer slots for Opening Day using the Sign Up Genius signup link; reiterate that children and players are not permitted in the snack shack for the event.
